description: This file is a PHP template partial for rendering related blog posts on a webpage. It checks if there are related posts, and if so, generates HTML with a loop to display each related post using an insertion of another template.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a sub-template with given variables, used here to render individual post widgets.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Retrieves translatable text strings, used here to get the 'blog-related-posts' heading.
